assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The symptoms are concerning for underlying arrhythmia
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The symptoms must be correlated with cardiac rhythm over an extended period
CPT 93247 is a long-term continuous electrocardiogram monitoring study
CPT 93247 is indicated to evaluate for potential atrial fibrillation or other dysrhythmias
The indication is stated in the clinical indication note
The claim was denied under Reason Code PR-204
The denial conflicts with the documented need for continuous rhythm monitoring tied to the patient's arrhythmia concern
